name: Use Both: Claude + Codex Workflow Kit
description_md:
Use Both: Claude + Codex Workflow Kit
Stop choosing one assistant for every job. Use one to plan and build, the other to challenge the work, and a simple handoff file to keep the project moving.

- 
Step-by-step guide: A polished 16-page PDF and editable Markdown walkthrough of all six workflows from the video.

- 
Nine copy-ready prompts: Planning and critique, image generation, code review, supervised computer use, bounded goals, and session continuity.

- 
Two installable skills: Public-safe, rewritten prime and handoff skills for Claude Code and Codex, plus a manual route for other assistants.

- 
Practical setup: A preview-first installer, official plugin and CLI routes, name-collision guidance, and troubleshooting.

- 
Worked example: A fictional task-board feature with runnable tests, showing how a specific critique turns into a better plan.

- 
Editable templates: Task brief, plan, review, and handoff forms you can adapt to your own project.

This is a public-safe teaching kit, not a copy of my private workspace or private skill wording. No client data, account credentials, or private session history is included.
